app.commerce-order.title: Commerce Order
app.commerce-order.state.empty: Open an order to see and edit everything about it in one place.
app.commerce-order.overview.hint: Read-only mirror of the order in Shopify. Editing lives in the Note, Tags and Custom attributes sections; writes go to Shopify and the mirror follows via webhook.
app.commerce-order.lineItems.editGuard: Quantity and add-item editing (Shopify's Order Editing) is a follow-up phase — line items are read-only here for now.
app.commerce-order.lineItems.lockedCance: This order is cancelled and cannot be edited in Shopify.
app.commerce-order.lineItems.lockedFulfi: This order is fulfilled — fulfilled items cannot have their quantity changed in Shopify.
app.commerce-order.lineItems.empty: No line items on this order.
app.commerce-order.lineItems.col.title: Item
app.commerce-order.note.hint: The order note stored in Shopify.
app.commerce-order.tags.hint: The order's Shopify tags. Save writes the tags to Shopify.
app.commerce-order.attributes.hint: The order's custom attributes (key / value). Save writes them to Shopify.
app.commerce-order.addresses.hint: The order's shipping and billing addresses (read-only).
app.commerce-order.hint.adminApiOff: The Shopify Admin API is disabled (see Commerce settings) — order edits cannot be written.
app.commerce-order.confirm.saveMsg: Write your changes to "{name}" to Shopify?
app.commerce-order.confirm.note: The change is written to Shopify via the Admin API; the CMS mirror is re-ingested asynchronously by webhook.
app.commerce-order.status.saved: Saved to Shopify. The mirror follows via webhook.
app.commerce-order.dialog.title: Unsaved Changes
app.commerce-order.dialog.body1: You have unsaved changes to this order.
app.commerce-order.dialog.body2: Do you want to save them to Shopify first?
